versions.subject: rule: exploitation of CVE-2019-1388
versions.detection:
selection:
    ParentImage: '*\consent.exe'
    Image: '*\iexplore.exe'
rights1:
    IntegrityLevel: 'System'  # for Sysmon users
rights2: 
    User: 'NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM'  # for non-Sysmon users - English language settings
condition: selection and ( rights1 or rights2 )
versions.spl: ParentImage="*\\consent.exe" Image="*\\iexplore.exe" IntegrityLevel="System" OR User="NT AUTHORITY\\SYSTEM"
